description: A Chrome extension for tracking daily goals with timers, counters, and checkboxes. See FEATURES.md for full specifications.

userStories.title: Project Initialization
userStories.description: Create the basic project folder structure for a Chrome extension. Create folders: src/, src/popup/, src/background/, src/styles/, src/utils/, src/assets/, src/assets/icons/, src/assets/sounds/. This sets up the foundation for all subsequent development.

userStories.title: Chrome Extension Manifest
userStories.description: Create manifest.json for Chrome Extension Manifest V3. Configure: name, version, description, permissions (storage, alarms, notifications), action (popup), service_worker, and icons. Reference FEATURES.md for required permissions.
acceptanceCriteria: manifest.json created with Manifest V3 format

userStories.title: Extension Icons
userStories.description: Create simple extension icons in 16x16, 48x48, and 128x128 pixel sizes. Use a simple design - a checkmark or goal/target icon. Can use SVG converted to PNG or simple canvas-generated icons. Place in src/assets/icons/.
acceptanceCriteria: Icons are visually clear and represent goal tracking

userStories.title: Popup HTML Structure
userStories.description: Create src/popup/popup.html with the basic HTML structure. Include: doctype, head with meta charset and viewport, link to popup.css, container div for app, script tag for popup.js. Set up semantic structure for a single-page app with multiple screens.
acceptanceCriteria: popup.html created with proper HTML5 structure
Viewport meta tag for proper scaling

userStories.title: Base CSS Styles
userStories.description: Create src/popup/popup.css with base styles. Define: CSS reset, CSS variables for colors (--primary, --secondary, --background, --text, --success, --danger), base typography, popup dimensions (380px width, 500px height). Reference FEATURES.md UI Specifications.
acceptanceCriteria: Base font family and sizes defined

userStories.title: Service Worker Setup
userStories.description: Create src/background/service-worker.js with basic Chrome extension service worker. Set up: chrome.runtime.onInstalled listener, placeholder for alarm listeners, placeholder for message listeners. This will handle background tasks like timers and resets.

userStories.title: Storage Utility Module
userStories.description: Create src/utils/storage.js with helper functions for Chrome storage API. Implement: getGoals(), saveGoals(goals), getActivityLog(), saveActivityLog(log), getSettings(), saveSettings(settings). Use chrome.storage.local. All functions should be async and handle errors gracefully.
acceptanceCriteria: storage.js created with all CRUD helpers
Functions exported for use in other modules

userStories.title: Goal Data Model
userStories.description: Create src/utils/models.js defining the Goal data structure and factory function. Goal has: id (uuid), title (string), type (timer|counter|checkbox), target (number), progress (number), timeframe (daily|weekly|monthly|yearly), category (string|null), isActive (boolean), createdAt (timestamp), lastResetAt (timestamp), order (number). Include createGoal() factory function.

userStories.title: Activity Log Data Model
userStories.description: Create ActivityLog data structure in src/utils/models.js. ActivityLog has: id (uuid), goalId (uuid), timestamp (number), action (start|pause|increment|decrement|toggle|reset|complete), value (number|null). Include createActivityLog() factory function.

userStories.title: Popup JavaScript Entry Point
userStories.description: Create src/popup/popup.js as the main entry point. Set up: DOMContentLoaded listener, import storage utilities, initialize app state, create basic router for screens (viewGoals, manageGoals, reports, settings). Start with viewGoals as default screen.
acceptanceCriteria: Loads and displays viewGoals by default

userStories.title: View Goals Screen - Header
userStories.description: Create the header section for View Goals screen. Display: App title 'Daily Goals', quick stats showing 'X/Y completed today' and current streak 'N day streak'. Style with flexbox, make it visually prominent. Stats should update from stored data.
acceptanceCriteria: Stats load from storage on init

userStories.title: View Goals Screen - Empty State
userStories.description: Create empty state for when no goals exist. Show: friendly message 'No goals yet', icon or illustration, prominent button 'Add Your First Goal' that navigates to Manage Goals screen. Center vertically in the goals list area.
acceptanceCriteria: Only shows when goals array is empty

userStories.title: View Goals Screen - Navigation Footer
userStories.description: Create bottom navigation for View Goals screen. Two buttons: 'Manage Goals' (gear/edit icon) and 'Reports' (chart icon). Fixed at bottom of popup. Clicking navigates to respective screens.

userStories.title: View Goals Screen - Goals List Container
userStories.description: Create scrollable goals list container for View Goals screen. Should sit between header and footer, scroll independently, have subtle styling. Prepare for rendering goal cards.

userStories.title: Goal Card - Base Component
userStories.description: Create reusable goal card component function renderGoalCard(goal). Base structure: card container, title, timeframe badge (daily/weekly/monthly/yearly with colors), progress bar. Style cards with shadow, rounded corners, proper spacing.

userStories.title: Goal Card - Timer Type Controls
userStories.description: Extend goal card for timer type goals. Add: Play/Pause toggle button (icon changes based on isActive), time display in HH:MM:SS format, progress bar showing progress/target. Play starts timer, Pause pauses it.

userStories.title: Goal Card - Counter Type Controls
userStories.description: Extend goal card for counter type goals. Add: Decrement button (-), current count display, Increment button (+), target display (e.g., '5 / 10'). Decrement minimum is 0. Show progress as current/target.

userStories.title: Goal Card - Checkbox Type Controls
userStories.description: Extend goal card for checkbox type goals. Add: Large clickable checkbox, completion state styling (strike-through title, green checkmark). Toggle on click.

userStories.title: Goal Card - Completion State
userStories.description: Add visual completion state to all goal cards. When progress >= target: show green border/glow, show checkmark icon, optional confetti animation. Make it feel rewarding!

userStories.title: Manage Goals Screen - Layout
userStories.description: Create Manage Goals screen layout. Include: Back button (arrow) to return to View Goals, 'Manage Goals' title, 'Add Goal' button (prominent, primary color), scrollable list of existing goals.
acceptanceCriteria: Back button navigates to View Goals

userStories.title: Manage Goals - Goal List Item
userStories.description: Create goal list item for Manage Goals screen. Different from View Goals - shows: goal title, type icon, timeframe badge, Edit button, Delete button. No progress controls here.

userStories.title: Add Goal Form - Modal
userStories.description: Create Add Goal form as a modal/overlay. Include: Close button (X), form title 'Add New Goal', form fields container, Save and Cancel buttons at bottom. Overlay darkens background.

userStories.title: Add Goal Form - Title Input
userStories.description: Add title input field to goal form. Label: 'Goal Title', placeholder: 'e.g., Study for exam', required field with validation. Show error message if empty on submit.

userStories.title: Add Goal Form - Type Selector
userStories.description: Add goal type selector to form. Three options as button group or radio: Timer (clock icon), Counter (number icon), Checkbox (check icon). Default to Timer. Selection changes which target input shows.

userStories.title: Add Goal Form - Target Input (Timer)
userStories.description: Add target input for Timer type. Show when Timer is selected. Label: 'Target Time'. Input for hours and minutes (two number inputs or single with HH:MM format). Convert to seconds for storage.
acceptanceCriteria: Shows only when Timer type selected

userStories.title: Add Goal Form - Target Input (Counter)
userStories.description: Add target input for Counter type. Show when Counter is selected. Label: 'Target Count'. Number input with min 1. Placeholder: 'e.g., 10'.
acceptanceCriteria: Shows only when Counter type selected

userStories.title: Add Goal Form - Timeframe Selector
userStories.description: Add timeframe selector to form. Dropdown or button group with options: Daily, Weekly, Monthly, Yearly. Default to Daily. Label: 'Reset Schedule'.
acceptanceCriteria: Tooltip or helper text explaining each

userStories.title: Add Goal Form - Save Logic
userStories.description: Implement Save button logic. Validate all required fields, create goal object using createGoal(), save to storage using saveGoals(), close modal, refresh goals list. Show success feedback.

userStories.title: Edit Goal - Pre-fill Form
userStories.description: Implement Edit functionality. When Edit button clicked, open the same form modal but: title says 'Edit Goal', form pre-filled with existing goal data, Save updates existing goal instead of creating new.

userStories.title: Delete Goal - Confirmation
userStories.description: Implement Delete functionality with confirmation. When Delete clicked, show confirmation dialog: 'Delete this goal? This cannot be undone.' with Cancel and Delete buttons. On confirm, remove from storage and refresh list.

userStories.title: Timer - Background Tracking
userStories.description: Implement persistent timer in service worker. When timer starts: store startTime and goalId in storage, set up interval or use alarms. When popup opens: calculate elapsed time from startTime. Timer must continue when popup is closed.

userStories.title: Timer - Play/Pause Logic
userStories.description: Implement Play/Pause toggle for timer goals. Play: set isActive=true, store startTime, send message to service worker. Pause: set isActive=false, calculate elapsed, add to progress, clear startTime. Log activity.

userStories.title: Timer - Live Display Update
userStories.description: Update timer display in real-time while popup is open. Use setInterval (1 second) to update HH:MM:SS display for active timers. Clear interval when popup closes or timer pauses.

userStories.title: Counter - Increment Logic
userStories.description: Implement increment for counter goals. Click +: increase progress by 1, save to storage, log activity with timestamp, update UI, check if goal completed.

userStories.title: Counter - Decrement Logic
userStories.description: Implement decrement for counter goals. Click -: decrease progress by 1 (minimum 0), save to storage, log activity with timestamp, update UI.

userStories.title: Checkbox - Toggle Logic
userStories.description: Implement toggle for checkbox goals. Click: toggle progress between 0 and 1 (target is always 1), save to storage, log activity with timestamp, update UI, check completion.

userStories.title: Sound - Audio Utility
userStories.description: Create src/utils/sounds.js with sound playing utility. Use Web Audio API or HTMLAudioElement. Functions: playSound(soundName), setVolume(level), setMuted(bool). Load sounds from src/assets/sounds/.

userStories.title: Sound - Effect Files
userStories.description: Add sound effect files to src/assets/sounds/. Need: complete.mp3 (goal complete chime), tick.mp3 (counter/checkbox), start.mp3 (timer start), pause.mp3 (timer pause). Use short, satisfying sounds (can generate or use free sounds).

userStories.title: Sound - Integration
userStories.description: Integrate sounds into goal interactions. Play: complete.mp3 when goal reaches target, tick.mp3 on counter increment/decrement and checkbox toggle, start.mp3 on timer play, pause.mp3 on timer pause.

userStories.title: Auto Reset - Alarm Setup
userStories.description: Set up Chrome alarms for automatic goal resets. On extension install/update: create alarms for midnight (daily check), Monday midnight (weekly check), 1st midnight (monthly check), Jan 1 midnight (yearly check).

userStories.title: Auto Reset - Reset Logic
userStories.description: Implement goal reset logic in service worker. When alarm fires: check each goal's timeframe, if reset is due: archive current progress to history, reset progress to 0, update lastResetAt, save goals.

userStories.title: History Storage Model
userStories.description: Create history data model in models.js. HistoryEntry: id, goalId, date, progress, target, completed (bool). Create getHistory(), saveHistory() in storage.js. History stores past completion data for reports.

userStories.title: Reports Screen - Layout
userStories.description: Create Reports screen layout. Include: Back button, 'Reports' title, discipline score section (large number display), streak section, stats cards area, placeholder for charts.

userStories.title: Reports - Discipline Score
userStories.description: Calculate and display discipline score. Formula: (completed goals / total goals) * 100 averaged over last 7 days. Display as large number with label 'Discipline Score' and color coding (green >80, yellow >50, red <50).

userStories.title: Reports - Streak Counter
userStories.description: Calculate and display current streak. Streak = consecutive days where ALL daily goals were completed. Show: current streak number, flame icon, 'day streak' label. Also show best streak ever.
acceptanceCriteria: Streak breaks if any goal missed

userStories.title: Reports - Completion Stats Cards
userStories.description: Display stat cards: 'Today' (X/Y), 'This Week' (X/Y), 'This Month' (X/Y). Each shows completed/total goals. Style as cards with icons.

userStories.title: Reports - Weekly Chart
userStories.description: Add simple bar chart showing last 7 days completion rate. X-axis: days (Mon-Sun), Y-axis: completion % (0-100). Use CSS or simple canvas drawing (no external library needed for basic chart).

userStories.title: Activity Timeline - Data Structure
userStories.description: Prepare activity log data for timeline visualization. Create function getActivityByHour(goalId, date) that groups activity by hour. Returns array of 24 values for hours 0-23.

userStories.title: Activity Timeline - Heatmap
userStories.description: Display activity heatmap in Reports. Show grid: rows = days, columns = hours (0-23). Cell color intensity = activity level. Focus on timer goals showing when user worked.

userStories.title: Dark Mode - CSS Variables
userStories.description: Add dark mode CSS variables. Create :root (light) and [data-theme='dark'] (dark) variable sets. Dark: dark background, light text, adjusted colors for contrast. Keep same variable names.

userStories.title: Dark Mode - Toggle
userStories.description: Add dark mode toggle. Store preference in settings. On load: check system preference (prefers-color-scheme), then user preference. Add toggle in settings screen. Apply by setting data-theme attribute on html.

userStories.title: Settings Screen
userStories.description: Create Settings screen. Include: Back button, 'Settings' title, Sound toggle (on/off), Volume slider, Dark mode toggle, About section with version. Accessible from View Goals via gear icon.

userStories.title: Browser Badge - Goal Count
userStories.description: Show incomplete goals count on extension badge. Update badge when: goals change, goal completed, reset occurs. Use chrome.action.setBadgeText() and setBadgeBackgroundColor().

userStories.title: Extension Load Test
userStories.description: Manually test extension loads in Chrome. Load unpacked extension, verify: popup opens, no console errors, storage works, all screens accessible. Fix any issues found.
